# Public Preview of Geo-redundancy in Azure App Service

## What Changed

Announcing the public preview of Geo-redundancy in Azure App Service Build resilient, multi-region applications with less complexity using managed regional replicas, application synchronization, and traffic routing. Building resilient web applications across Azure regions has traditionally meant deploying and maintaining separate applications, coordinating releases and configuration, and implementing traffic routing and failover. That work is important, but it adds operational complexity that can distract teams from delivering application value. Today, at Microsoft Ignite 2026, we’re announcing the public preview of Geo-redundancy in Azure App Service. It brings managed regional application replicas, supported application content and configuration synchronization, health-based routing, and regional failover into a unified App Service experience. Multi-region resiliency, without managing every deployment independently With Geo-redundancy, you start with an eligible App Service web app and configure replicas in supported Azure regions.
